# Tempo Certo

Tempo Certo is a bilingual PT-BR / English browser chronology game created by Turetta.
Players receive six rounds per game, with four historical-event cards in each round, and must order them from oldest to newest.
The game has a three-games-per-day limit per authenticated Google account and a global Top 10 leaderboard based on accumulated score.

Canonical site: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/
Leaderboard: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/leaderboard
Privacy policy: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/terms

The public browser client does not receive event years until the player has submitted an immutable ordering for that round. Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore Security Rules, and separate public/private round documents are used to enforce this flow without a paid server runtime.
